head_coach.name: Ståle Solbakken
head_coach.play_style_summary: Norway focuses on a high press, verticality, and rapid transitions. The tactical approach emphasizes quick vertical progression rather than long spells of sideways possession, establishing a compact defensive block (often shifting into a 4-4-2 or 4-5-1 out of possession) to force turnovers high up the pitch.

key_players.name: Erling Haaland
key_players.performance_stats: Scored 16 goals in 8 matches during the World Cup qualifying campaign, establishing himself as Norway's all-time top scorer.

key_players.name: Martin Ødegaard
key_players.performance_stats: The team's captain and primary playmaker, serving as a talismanic figure who led Norway to end their 26-year wait for a World Cup return.

key_players.name: Antonio Nusa
key_players.performance_stats: A breakout star in the attack who scored a crucial goal against Italy in the final qualifying matches to secure World Cup spot.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Sidelined due to a minor knock/muscular issue.
